deploy.//migrations: MVP runs ONE instance, so migrating in startCommand is safe. Before scaling to >1 instance, set this as a Railway Pre-Deploy Command instead (see docs/DEPLOY.md) so concurrent boots can't race the migration — the way fly.toml uses release_command.
deploy.startCommand: uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips '*'
